title: Retry failed deployment

requirements.text: Review the current backend and frontend code for any compilation errors, syntax issues, or configuration problems that may have caused the deployment to fail, fix them, and redeploy the application successfully.
acceptanceCriteria: The application compiles without errors in both backend (Motoko) and frontend (TypeScript/React)
The deployment completes successfully without timeout or network errors
The live application is accessible and functional after deployment

constraints: Do not change any existing features or data models — this is a fix-and-redeploy only
nonGoals: Changing existing UI or backend logic beyond what is needed to fix deployment errors
